message.content:
**Yes – you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta, but it’s handled through the city’s enforcement agencies rather than the City Council itself.** | What you need | How to do it | Contact | |---------------|--------------|---------| | **Noise complaint** | • Call 311 (or 404‑656‑3111) during business hours.
• Use the online 311 portal:
• Visit the City Hall in person (55 Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Atlanta, GA 30303). | • 311 (phone & online)
• City Hall (in‑person) | | **Information to provide** | • Date & time of the disturbance.
• Location (address or intersection).
• Description of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs).
• Any evidence (audio clip, photos, witness statements). | | | **Who enforces** | • The Atlanta Police Department (APD) will investigate and may issue a citation if the noise violates the city’s ordinance.
• The City of Atlanta’s Code Enforcement Office handles certain civil violations and can refer cases to the APD. | | | **City noise ordinance** | • Atlanta’s Noise Ordinance (City Code Chapter 10, Article 1) sets limits on decibel levels and defines “noisy” activities.
• Violations can result in fines, summonses, or civil action. | | | **City Council’s role** | • The City Council passes and amends the noise ordinance, but it does not process individual complaints.
• If you believe the ordinance is unfair or needs change, you can bring it to a Council meeting or submit a written request. | | | **Timeline** | • Complaints are typically addressed within 24 hours of filing.
• If a citation is issued, you’ll receive a summons and have the right to contest it in court. | | ### Quick Steps to File 1. **Call 311** (or use the online portal) and give the dispatcher the details above. 2. **If you prefer in‑person**, go to City Hall and speak with the Code Enforcement Officer. 3. **Keep a record** of the complaint number and any reference you receive. 4. **Follow up** if you don’t hear back within a few days; you can call 311 again or email 311@atlantaga.gov. ### Useful Links - **Atlanta 311 Portal**: - **City Code – Noise Ordinance**: (search for “Noise Ordinance”) - **City Hall Address**: 55 Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Atlanta, GA 30303 - **City Hall Phone**: 404‑656‑3111 If you’re dealing with a recurring issue (e.g., a neighbor’s construction or a pet that’s always barking), it can help to document each incident with dates, times, and any evidence. That makes it easier for the city to take action. Feel free to let me know if you need help drafting a complaint or understanding the specific fines associated with noise violations!
